description: Department of Local Government - Southern Province - The meeting for the Purpose of electing to fill the Vacancy of the Mayor of Hambantota Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the convening of a meeting to elect the Mayor of the Hambantota Municipal Council. It is made under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and specifically deals with electoral processes for local government, falling clearly under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) which covers election announcements, schedules, and related electoral matters.
